summary.intent: Open a docs-only PR (trail #357) in a fresh worktree off origin/main that tidies pending .changeset/*.md bodies so the next changelog is scannable: delete one changeset for unreleased behaviour, trim and split others, and make bullet labels consistent, without touching bump frontmatter.
summary.outcome: Deleted brave-tigers-bound.md, rewrote brave-panthers-climb, noble-leopards-run and swift-foxes-sprint, normalised labels across other changesets via sed, ran just doc-check and just pre-push, and retried the signed commit outside the sandbox. The transcript ends at the commit; merge, push, ls-remote, entire trail ci-pr and the 3-line report are not shown as done, and the exit codes of the checks are not recorded.

repo: AGENTS.md changeset rules: a fix to unreleased behaviour gets no changeset (e.g. the #589 race only exists with inferred release PRs, which are new in this release), so such changesets are deleted.

Changeset bodies use a fixed label vocabulary: bold **Why it matters:**, **How to adopt:**, **Limits:** in that order when a bullet's role is not obvious, otherwise plain bullets; **Scripting:**, **Breaking:** and **Action:** are separate paragraphs.
Breaking changes get one **Breaking:** paragraph per change with old behaviour, new behaviour and what to do, plus a single consolidated **Action:** paragraph.
The workflow regeneration Action (callisto init --workflow, close stray release PR) belongs in brave-panthers-climb.md, not in other changesets.
The repo has 24 changesets in .changeset/; the task requires editing bodies only, never bump frontmatter.
Tokenless publishing is documented in docs/publishing.md (needs Node 22.14+ and npm 11.5.1+, not yet verified on real registries).
workflow: Commit signing (git commit -S) needs access to ~/.gnupg, which the sandbox blocks; retry the commit outside the sandbox rather than dropping the signature.
BSD sed on macOS requires `sed -i ''`; multi-line edits and appends via printf/cat were fragile, and writing the whole file with the Write tool was more reliable.
Delivery order for this task: signed commit with no trailer, merge origin/main, push to HEAD:refs/heads/docs/changeset-tidy, verify with git ls-remote, then run entire trail ci-pr.

friction: Several git fetch/reset and cat commands were issued repeatedly at the start, suggesting early calls were blocked or produced no output.
A multi-command Bash edit on swift-cheetahs-sprint.md did not run, so the file had to be rewritten with Write.
The sandbox blocked GPG signing, forcing a retry of the commit outside the sandbox.
A stray double-space in noble-foxes-fly.md bullets (`-  \`==\``) needed a separate sed fix, which was run twice.
open_items: Merge origin/main, push to HEAD:refs/heads/docs/changeset-tidy, verify with ls-remote and run entire trail ci-pr (not shown in the transcript).
